description: Scaffold the solution and build the shared Core project: root build configuration with central package pinning, the no-LINQ MSBuild warning, .editorconfig, six projects with correct one-way references, the typed configuration layer, the single ElementWaits helper, the WebDriver lifecycle classes, failure-artefact capture and the Core DI registration extensions. No feature files and no tests yet - this feature's job is a solution that restores and builds clean with 0 warnings. FEAT-002, FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 all depend on it.
steps: Record the new pins in steering BEFORE using them, because tech-stack.md forbids a package without a decision recorded there. Add three rows to the Active table in d:\git\QAAutomation\.kiro\steering\tech-stack.md: Refit.HttpClientFactory 16.3.0 (api-automation.md section 1.4 mandates IHttpClientFactory registration), Microsoft.Extensions.Http 10.0.12 (the IHttpClientFactory implementation, matching the net10.0 TFM), Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions 10.0.12 (Core's registration extension needs IServiceCollection). Add a one-line note in the same file that Refit 16 registers through AddRefitGeneratedClient<T>() because AddRefitClient<T>() fails at run time demanding the separate Refit.Reflection package. Change no other row.

Add a @marketing row to the feature-area dimension of the tag taxonomy table in d:\git\QAAutomation\.kiro\steering\bdd-gherkin-standards.md, because that table says a new area tag may only be added by updating it first and none of @vat/@bankrec/@mtd/@invoicing/@payments/@permissions fits a marketing website.

Create d:\git\QAAutomation\Directory.Build.props: TargetFramework net10.0, LangVersion latest, ImplicitUsings disable (the SDK implicit set includes System.Linq), Nullable disable (code-style.md's own snippets assign null to non-nullable locals), TreatWarningsAsErrors false, EnforceCodeStyleInBuild true, IsPackable false.

Create d:\git\QAAutomation\Directory.Packages.props with ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true, CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled=true and exactly one PackageVersion row per package in context.json's pinned_package_versions. Add nothing else: no reserved package (WireMock.Net, Testcontainers.PostgreSql, Npgsql, Respawn, Bogus, Polly, Allure.Reqnroll, Reqnroll.Verify, RestSharp stay unpinned until activated), and never Selenium.WebDriver.ChromeDriver, WebDriverManager, DotNetSeleniumExtras.WaitHelpers or FluentAssertions.

Create d:\git\QAAutomation\Directory.Build.targets with a WarnOnLinqUsage target, AfterTargets=Build, conditioned on '$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'. Build an ItemGroup HandWrittenSource from @(Compile) with Exclude="$(BaseIntermediateOutputPath)**\*.cs;obj\**\*.cs;bin\**\*.cs", run Exec with Command="findstr /M /C:"using System.Linq" @(HandWrittenSource->'"%(FullPath)"', ' ')" plus ContinueOnError=true, IgnoreExitCode=true, StandardOutputImportance=low and ConsoleToMSBuild=true capturing ConsoleOutput into an item named LinqOffender, then emit a <Warning> conditioned on '@(LinqOffender)' != '' naming the offending files and pointing at .kiro/steering/code-style.md. It must be a WARNING only and must never fail the build.

Create d:\git\QAAutomation\.editorconfig with root = true; a [*] section with utf-8, crlf, insert_final_newline, trim_trailing_whitespace, indent_style space and indent_size 4; a [*.{feature,json,yml,yaml,md}] section with indent_size 2; a [*.cs] section setting csharp_style_var_for_built_in_types, csharp_style_var_when_type_is_apparent and csharp_style_var_elsewhere all to false:suggestion (code-style.md wants explicit types, and suggestion severity avoids false build warnings on the allowed 'var x = new Foo()' form) and dotnet_diagnostic.IDE0005.severity = warning so an abandoned using directive shows up; and a [*.feature.cs] section with generated_code = true so Reqnroll's generated code is not judged by house style.

Create d:\git\QAAutomation\.gitignore covering bin/, obj/, test-results/, TestResults/, *.trx, *.user, .vs/ and allure-results/. The workspace is not a git repository yet, but the file is part of the template.

Create the solution and the six projects. Run dotnet new sln -n QAAutomation at d:\git\QAAutomation, then dotnet new classlib for src\QAAutomation.Core, src\QAAutomation.UI, src\QAAutomation.Api, tests\QAAutomation.Tests.UI, tests\QAAutomation.Tests.Api and tests\QAAutomation.Tests.E2E. Use classlib for the test projects too and add the test packages by hand - do NOT use dotnet new nunit, which writes its own package versions. Delete every generated Class1.cs. Add all six projects to the solution.

Write the six .csproj files by hand so every PackageReference has NO Version attribute. Core: Selenium.WebDriver, Selenium.Support, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Json, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.EnvironmentVariables, Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions, no ProjectReference, no test runner. UI: ProjectReference to Core only. Api: ProjectReference to Core plus Refit, Refit.HttpClientFactory, Microsoft.Extensions.Http, Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions. Each of the three test projects: IsTestProject true, plus Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, NUnit, NUnit3TestAdapter, Reqnroll.NUnit, Reqnroll.Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, AwesomeAssertions. Tests.UI references Core and UI; Tests.Api references Core and Api; Tests.E2E references Core, UI and Api. No test project references another test project.

In each of the three test .csproj files add <None Include="..\..\src\QAAutomation.Core\Configuration\appsettings.json" Link="appsettings.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" /> so the settings file lands in the test output deterministically rather than relying on transitive content flow.

Create the configuration layer under d:\git\QAAutomation\src\QAAutomation.Core\Configuration: appsettings.json with the four sections WebDriver (Browser 'chrome', Headless true, WindowWidth 1920, WindowHeight 1080, ElementTimeoutSeconds 20, PageLoadTimeoutSeconds 60), Api (BaseUrl https://www.landmarksystems.co.uk/wp-json/wp/v2, TimeoutSeconds 30, TenantId YOUR_TENANT_ID_HERE, ApiKey YOUR_API_KEY_HERE), Site (BaseUrl https://www.landmarksystems.co.uk, HomePageTitle 'Farm & Rural Estate Management Software | Landmark Systems', ContactPagePath /contact-us/, KnownPageSlug technical, MissingPageId 999999, MinimumPageSize 1, MaximumPageSize 100) and Artefacts (Directory test-results). Only placeholders for anything secret-shaped - the public base URLs are not secrets, but ApiKey and TenantId must stay as placeholders and are unused against WordPress; they exist to demonstrate the override pattern.

Create WebDriverOptions.cs, ApiOptions.cs, SiteOptions.cs and ArtefactOptions.cs in Configuration as plain classes with settable properties, no attributes and no behaviour, plus TestConfiguration.cs as a plain holder exposing all four.

Create Configuration\TestConfigurationLoader.cs with public static TestConfiguration Load(): build an IConfigurationRoot from AddJsonFile(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "appsettings.json"), optional: false) then AddEnvironmentVariables("QAAUTOMATION_"), read every value through GetSection(...) with explicit assignment (no Get<T>(), because the Binder package is deliberately not pinned), and validate with guard clauses: Site:BaseUrl and Api:BaseUrl absolute and https, timeouts between 1 and 300 seconds, WindowWidth >= 320, WindowHeight >= 480, HomePageTitle non-empty after trim, ContactPagePath starts with /, KnownPageSlug non-empty, MissingPageId > 0, and 1 <= MinimumPageSize <= MaximumPageSize <= 100. Create Configuration\TestConfigurationException.cs whose message names the exact configuration key and the offending value and never dumps the whole configuration object, because it can carry an injected key.

Create Core\Utilities\ElementWaits.cs - the ONE wait helper for the whole repository, constructed with (IWebDriver driver, TimeSpan timeout) and built on WebDriverWait from Selenium.Support. Public methods: WaitUntilVisible(By), WaitUntilClickable(By), WaitUntilFirstVisible(By) returning the first Displayed match, WaitUntilGone(By) and WaitUntilTitleContains(string). One private CreateWait() that news up the WebDriverWait and calls IgnoreExceptionTypes(typeof(NoSuchElementException), typeof(StaleElementReferenceException)) so a Vue-style re-render retries inside the bounded timeout instead of failing on the first blink. Every Until lambda in the repository is written here and nowhere else, each with the code-style.md exception-2 comment above it.

Create the rest of Core\Utilities: TestIdLocator.cs with ByTestId(string) over a data-testid const and a header comment saying it is deliberately unused against the WordPress placeholder because a third-party site has no test ids, and that it becomes the primary strategy on KEYinfinity; HeaderValueReader.cs with static string ReadFirstValue(HttpResponseHeaders headers, string name) using TryGetValues then a foreach with break, returning null when absent; PositiveIntegerParser.cs with static bool TryParsePositive(string value, out int result) using int.TryParse with NumberStyles.Integer and CultureInfo.InvariantCulture then > 0; FileNameSanitiser.cs with static string ToSafeFileName(string value) doing a foreach over chars, replacing anything outside A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ with -, capped at 80 characters and no regex; UrlHostChecker.cs with static bool HasSameHost(string expectedBaseUrl, string candidateUrl) doing a case-insensitive host compare, used to guard the E2E hand-off because a URL from a response is untrusted input; and ArtefactPaths.cs with static string ForScenario(string configuredDirectory, string suiteName, string scenarioTitle) that uses configuredDirectory as-is when rooted, otherwise walks up from AppContext.BaseDirectory until it finds a folder containing QAAutomation.sln (falling back to AppContext.BaseDirectory) so artefacts land in the discoverable repo-root test-results folder rather than inside bin, then creates <root>\<configuredDirectory>\<suite>\<sanitised title>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>\.

Create Core\Support\WebDriverFactory.cs with static IWebDriver Create(WebDriverOptions options): a guard clause throwing TestConfigurationException naming WebDriver:Browser for anything other than 'chrome'; ChromeOptions with --headless=new when Headless, --window-size=<width>,<height>, --disable-gpu, and SetLoggingPreference(LogType.Browser, LogLevel.All) so console logs are capturable; then Manage().Timeouts().ImplicitWait = TimeSpan.Zero (implicit and explicit waits interact badly) and PageLoad from configuration. Add a comment stating Selenium Manager resolves the driver automatically, which is why there is no driver package and no install step.

Create Core\Support\ScenarioDriver.cs holding the per-scenario IWebDriver with Start(), Quit() (which calls Quit() then Dispose(), never Close(), because Close() leaves the driver process running), an IsStarted flag, and a Driver property whose guard throws a plain-English InvalidOperationException if the browser was never started.

Create Core\Support\FailureArtefacts.cs with Capture(string suiteName, string scenarioTitle) writing screenshot.png via ITakesScreenshot, page-source.html from driver.PageSource, console.log from driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(LogType.Browser) inside a try/catch (WebDriverException) so a missing log cannot break teardown, and location.txt holding driver.Url and driver.Title - all into the ArtefactPaths folder. Add a comment warning that page source and console logs can carry tokens and PII and must never be published unmasked.
Create Core\Support\ScenarioCorrelation.cs as a scoped class exposing one CorrelationId GUID per scenario, used in artefact folder names and sent as a request header so UI and API evidence line up.

Create d:\git\QAAutomation\src\QAAutomation.Core\CoreRegistration.cs with two IServiceCollection extension methods: AddTestConfiguration(TestConfiguration) registering the four options objects as CONCRETE singletons (services.AddSingleton(webDriverOptions)), never IOptions<T>, because a constructor parameter of WebDriverOptions is readable to a newcomer; and AddBrowserSupport() registering ScenarioDriver scoped, IWebDriver as a scoped factory reading ScenarioDriver.Driver, ElementWaits scoped with the timeout from WebDriverOptions, and FailureArtefacts and ScenarioCorrelation scoped.
acceptance_criteria: dotnet restore d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln succeeds with no NU1008 (a Version attribute under central management), no NU1605 downgrade and no version-conflict error.
dotnet build d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln reports 'Build succeeded', 0 Warning(s) and 0 Error(s).

Adding 'using System.Linq;' to one Core source file and rebuilding produces exactly one 'LINQ is banned' warning while still reporting 'Build succeeded' and 0 Error(s); removing the line returns the build to 0 warnings.
No .csproj contains a Version attribute on a PackageReference, and the solution contains no test project that references another test project.
d:\git\QAAutomation contains no pipelines folder and no leftover Class1.cs.
The committed appsettings.json contains no real key, token or connection string - only YOUR_TENANT_ID_HERE and YOUR_API_KEY_HERE placeholders.
verification: Add 'using System.Linq;' to a Core .cs file, run dotnet build d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln, confirm one 'LINQ is banned' warning and 'Build succeeded' with 0 Error(s), then delete the line and rebuild to 0 warnings
findings:
SURPRISE 1 - solution file format. On SDK 10.0.301 'dotnet new sln' defaults to the XML .slnx format, so the first attempt produced QAAutomation.slnx and every 'dotnet restore d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln' failed with MSB1009 Project file does not exist. Fixed by 'dotnet new sln -n QAAutomation --format sln' (the template has a -f|--format <sln|slnx> option). The classic d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln now exists and all six projects are in it. This matters beyond cosmetics: ArtefactPaths.FindRepositoryRoot walks up looking for the literal file name 'QAAutomation.sln', so if anyone ever migrates the solution to .slnx they must update the SolutionFileName const in src\QAAutomation.Core\Utilities\ArtefactPaths.cs or failure artefacts silently fall back to AppContext.BaseDirectory (i.e. inside bin).

SURPRISE 2 - IDE0005 needs a documentation file. The .editorconfig line dotnet_diagnostic.IDE0005.severity = warning does nothing on its own; Roslyn emits 'warning EnableGenerateDocumentationFile: Set MSBuild property GenerateDocumentationFile to true ... to enable IDE0005' instead, which is itself a warning and broke the 0-warning acceptance criterion. Fixed in Directory.Build.props by adding <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile> together with <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);CS1591</NoWarn>, both commented in place. CONSEQUENCE FOR LATER FEATURES: a public member with no XML comment is fine (CS1591 is suppressed), but an unused using directive anywhere is now a real build warning. Keep using blocks tight in feature steps, hooks and page objects or the build stops being 0-warning.

No ProjectReference. Plus <None Include="Configuration\appsettings.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />.

- tests\QAAutomation.Tests.UI: same package set; ProjectReference Core + UI.

CORE API SURFACE LATER FEATURES WILL CALL:
- QAAutomation.Core.Configuration: TestConfigurationLoader.Load() returns TestConfiguration { WebDriver, Api, Site, Artefacts }. Env override prefix is QAAUTOMATION_ with double-underscore section separator, e.g. QAAUTOMATION_WebDriver__Headless=false. TestConfigurationException.ForKey(configurationKey, problem, offendingValue) is the static factory - use it rather than the bare constructor so the message shape stays consistent.
- SiteOptions exposes BaseUrl, HomePageTitle, ContactPagePath, KnownPageSlug, MissingPageId, MinimumPageSize, MaximumPageSize. ApiOptions exposes BaseUrl, TimeoutSeconds, TenantId, ApiKey (the last two are YOUR_*_HERE placeholders, unused against WordPress).
- QAAutomation.Core.Utilities.ElementWaits (instance, scoped in DI): WaitUntilVisible(By), WaitUntilClickable(By), WaitUntilFirstVisible(By), WaitUntilGone(By) [void], WaitUntilTitleContains(string) [void]. WaitUntilFirstVisible is the one to use for the duplicated nav.site-header__navigation. All five Until lambdas live in this file; do not write another one anywhere.
- Static helpers: TestIdLocator.ByTestId(string) [ships unused, documented], HeaderValueReader.ReadFirstValue(HttpResponseHeaders, string) -> string or null, PositiveIntegerParser.TryParsePositive(string, out int), FileNameSanitiser.ToSafeFileName(string), UrlHostChecker.HasSameHost(string expectedBaseUrl, string candidateUrl), ArtefactPaths.ForScenario(configuredDirectory, suiteName, scenarioTitle) -> created folder path.
- QAAutomation.Core.Support: WebDriverFactory.Create(WebDriverOptions) [static]; ScenarioDriver with Start(), Quit(), IsStarted, Driver; FailureArtefacts.Capture(string suiteName, string scenarioTitle) returns the folder path or null when no browser was started - so a hook can call it unconditionally and it is a no-op for a non-UI scenario; ScenarioCorrelation with CorrelationId (Guid), CorrelationIdText (string) and the const HeaderName = "X-Correlation-Id" which RequestContextHandler should use.
- QAAutomation.Core.CoreRegistration: services.AddTestConfiguration(testConfiguration) registers TestConfiguration plus all four options objects as CONCRETE singletons; services.AddBrowserSupport() registers ScenarioDriver, ScenarioCorrelation, FailureArtefacts, IWebDriver and ElementWaits as scoped. Tests.Api must call AddTestConfiguration but NOT AddBrowserSupport.
- NOTE for FEAT-002/003: FailureArtefacts takes a constructor dependency on ScenarioDriver (not IWebDriver) on purpose, so resolving it in an AfterScenario hook cannot trigger the 'browser was never started' guard on ScenarioDriver.Driver.
- MINOR DEVIATION: ScenarioCorrelation's id is written into location.txt rather than into the artefact folder name, because ArtefactPaths.ForScenario keeps the exact three-parameter signature the plan specified and FileNameSanitiser caps a name at 80 characters, which could truncate an appended GUID. The folder is already unique via its yyyyMMdd-HHmmss suffix.
